title: Lodge a return of unclaimed money
what: Lodge a return of unclaimed money held at 30 June within 4 months, and pay the money to the Chief Commissioner.

sources.title: Unclaimed Money Act 1995 (NSW)
sources.publisher: NSW Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: An enterprise that holds unclaimed money on 30 June in any year must, within 4 months after that date (or such longer period as the Chief Commissioner may in a particular case allow), lodge with the Chief Commissioner a return relating to that money in a form approved by the Chief Commissioner

administration.who: Revenue NSW (Chief Commissioner of State Revenue)

sources.title: Unclaimed Money Act 1995 (NSW)
sources.publisher: NSW Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.locator: s 3, words naming the body (found 18 Nov 2026)
sources.quote: Chief Commissioner means the Chief Commissioner of State Revenue appointed under the Taxation Administration Act 1996.

reach.condition: if it holds unclaimed money (such as unpresented cheques or unclaimed customer credits) at 30 June
